name: Israel
sources: $62bn and 4.66m people, and 12.4% of GDP on defence — the highest share in the world outside the Gulf.
Central government debt is 132% of GDP, the hangover from 1985's stabilisation.
The military index is set well above what $62bn would buy anyone else: air superiority over every neighbour, US kit, and reserves that put half a million people in uniform in days.

Nuclear is true. Israel has never confirmed it and never will — the policy is called amimut, ambiguity — but the Dimona arsenal dates to the late 1960s and every capital in the region planned around it in 1990.
Separatism is the First Intifada, running since December 1987.

note: 1990 TECHNOLOGY: AUTHORED, NOT DERIVED. What this nation knew on 1 January 1990 is transcribed and sourced grant by grant, exactly like every other 1990 figure in this file, and is not read off tfp_trend - there was never a code path from the trend to the known set, and the zero that stood there was a claim about the world rather than an absence of one (BIBLE section 8 and iron rule 4, both amended 2026-08-30). THE PREDICATE IS SPLIT, and split by the technology's OWN EFFECT TYPE so that it is mechanically computable and never a per-nation judgement call. A node whose effects include MilitaryEfficiency, MilitaryStrength, DiffusionEmission or CostReduction is SOVEREIGNTY-SIDE: holding it means this nation could PRODUCE it, so operating an imported article does not qualify. Every other node is USE-SIDE: deployed and in operational use here is enough, whoever built it, because the effect such a node pays is a productivity, health or output effect and that effect is real in the country where the machine runs. Of the 48 technologies the tree lets anyone hold in 1990, 17 are sovereignty-side and 31 are use-side.

ALL 48 OF THE 1990-ELIGIBLE TECHNOLOGIES WERE RULED FOR THIS NATION, one at a time, against a standard published per technology rather than per country. 8 were held and are listed below with their citations; 40 were refused. The refused ids are named at the end of this note so that a reader can tell a cell that was examined and refused from a cell nobody looked at - those are different claims and the schema would otherwise flatten them into the same silence.

RULED AND REFUSED, ids only (the reasoning for each refusal is held with the board that wrote it, one standard per technology): core_packet_internetworking, core_single_mode_fiber, core_carbon_composites, core_combined_cycle_turbine, core_pcr, comp_risc_superscalar, comp_relational_database, comm_fibre_optic_backbone, comm_geostationary_comsat, ener_seismic_3d_imaging, ener_horizontal_drilling, ener_gas_turbine_combined_cycle, ener_crystalline_silicon_module, matl_semiconductor_lithography, matl_composite_structures, matl_industrial_robotics, matl_lean_production, matl_single_crystal_superalloy, matl_rare_earth_magnet, matl_stereolithography, aero_precision_munitions, aero_stealth_shaping, aero_quiet_submarine, aero_recon_satellite, bio_recombinant_pharma, bio_oral_rehydration, bio_conjugate_vaccine, bio_monoclonal_antibody, bio_automated_sequencing, tran_container_intermodal, tran_post_panamax_ship, tran_electronic_freight_documents, tran_high_speed_rail, agri_composite_membrane, agri_conservation_tillage, agri_integrated_pest_management, agri_protected_cultivation, agri_tissue_culture_propagation, agri_marine_aquaculture, agri_flue_gas_desulphurisation.

COLLISION RESOLVED. Two authoring boards ruled the same cell for this nation and disagreed. The tie-break is uniform across the whole roster and is not a preference between authors: the cell belongs to the board that owns the technology's domain in the registry, which for every non-core id is also its id prefix, and which both cross-domain authors published as their own deferral. core_packet_internetworking -> NOT HELD (semiconductors-computing said held, telecom-space said not held; resolved to the board that owns the Communications domain, telecom-space).

granted.source: Route (a) production. Intel Fab 8 in Jerusalem - Intel's first fabrication plant outside the United States - was in production from 1985, and Intel's own corporate timeline records that during the 1990s the Jerusalem plant produced 75% of Intel's 80386 microprocessors (timeline.intel.com/1985/intel-israel-and-the-beginning-of-worldwide-fabrication). The 386 is a part of exactly the generation this entry cites. Corroboration for use: IT.CMP.PCMP.P2 1990 = 6.74 PCs per 100.
World Bank IT.CMP.PCMP.P2 1990 = 6.74 PCs per 100, 2.8x the World value. Corroboration: Intel Fab 8, Jerusalem, in production from 1985 and making the 386 itself.

IAI Elta Systems designed and built the multimode pulse-Doppler fire-control radar carried by the IAI Lavi prototype from its first flight on 31 December 1986, and the EL/M-2021 airborne multimode radar family fitted to the Kfir C.7 in IAF service from 1983 and exported. Elta is a domestic design authority with domestic production. Moderate confidence on the C.7 radar's pulse-Doppler modes specifically; see low_confidence_cells.
WHO/UNICEF WUENIC DTP3 coverage, Israel, 1990: 93%. Series: WUENIC DTP3 ('Israel,ISR,1990,93').

Grant rests on the MRI-and-conventional-CT half. Elscint Ltd of Haifa manufactured computed-tomography scanners from the late 1970s and magnetic-resonance systems in the 1980s — one of a small handful of firms anywhere building both — and supplied Israeli hospitals as well as exporting. Israel is the smallest economy among the majors with a domestic cross-sectional imaging industry.

Estimates for 1991 put micro-irrigation on 70% of Israel's irrigated land, having grown from about 25,000 acres in 1975 - Workforce LibreTexts, Irrigation Systems Management (AET 021), 14.2 'Microirrigation: History and Impact'. Netafim was founded in 1965 at Kibbutz Hatzerim on Simcha Blass's pressure-compensating emitter; Israel is the first of the two deployments the tree's own entry comment reads its 1990 floor off (spheres-sim/src/tech/agriculture.rs:45-49).
